title: PeopleOS — an engineering walkthrough
delivery: Helpful, composed product narration. Natural full sentences, one consistent synthetic voice, unhurried transitions. Preserve the speaker's pace and record visuals to the resulting chapter timeline.

chapters.title: Meet PeopleOS
chapters.text: Meet People O S, a working people operations system built by Alloyce Amos. It brings migration checks, support workflows, and human approvals into one connected workspace.

chapters.title: A connected workspace
chapters.text: Forty-eight fictional employees span thirteen countries. The directory, quality metrics, and country views all read from the same records, so the numbers stay connected as the data changes.

chapters.title: Understand the exceptions
chapters.text: In the migration hub, every exception has a clear explanation. You can compare the original value with the proposed correction and see the rule that raised it.

chapters.title: Validate before importing
chapters.text: Before an import, the migration lab parses the C S V and validates its fields. It reports missing values, duplicate identifiers, and invalid references without changing an employee record.

chapters.title: Run the specialist tools
chapters.text: The agent studio makes the work visible. Specialist tools extract the source, map its fields, check the records, and reconcile the proposed result.

chapters.title: Inspect the evidence
chapters.text: Each step has an inspectable output. These are real, deterministic checks. Optional A I helps explain the findings, while the decision to apply a change stays with the reviewer.

chapters.title: Approve a reviewed proposal
chapters.text: After reviewing the proposal, approve the sixteen corrections. The sample records update, the open issues clear, and the data-quality measure reaches one hundred percent.

chapters.title: Coordinate people operations
chapters.text: The same approach extends to service requests. Teams review proposed assignments before they are applied. Onboarding and payroll readiness each have their own workflow and approval boundary.

chapters.title: Explain the system
chapters.text: The people copilot answers in English or French, with visible references and optional browser voice. It can explain a migration or guide a new starter using clearly labeled example policies.

chapters.title: Follow the result
chapters.text: Finally, the audit trail connects the decision to its result. Explore the live demo, inspect a workflow, or open the source to see the engineering behind the interface.
